title: SAP S-4HANA - Simply Explained
description:
SAP says its customers generate more than eighty-seven percent of global commerce, and most of that runs through software you never see. The newest release of that software is called SAP S/4HANA, and the name makes it sound far more complicated than it is.

In this episode of Simply Explained you will learn:
  • What SAP S/4HANA Actually Is
  • Why the Database Underneath Changed Everything
  • The New Interface and the Simplified Data Model
  • The Business Areas It Covers
  • How Companies Actually Run It
  • How You Get There, and the 2027 Clock
  • Keeping the Core Clean
  • Where S/4HANA Meets Microsoft
  • The Honest Limits and Common Mistakes
  • What to Take Away

Simply Explained by M365.FM breaks down Microsoft 365, Azure and modern IT topics in clear, jargon-free language. Hosted by Mirko Peters.
